data.name: Step1_Headline
data.value: A browser and WebDriver are required

data.name: Step1_Description
data.value: First install a supported web browser. To automate it, you also need at least one matching WebDriver.

data.name: Step2_Description
data.value:
Browser: Google Chrome is configured by default. Install it here: https://www.google.com/chrome
WebDriver: ChromeDriver is also preconfigured. Download the version matching your browser here: https://developer.chrome.com/docs/chromedriver/downloads
